name: Code Graph
description: AST-based code entity search. Extracts modules, classes, functions, APIs, and cross-service interactions across 10+ languages; exposes search_code_graph and query_code_structure tools.

install._note: Code graph lives inside the same orchestrator repo as vct-kg. Installing vct-kg already brings the code graph scripts; this module describes them as a separate capability for the Store/Dashboard UI.

settings.description: gpu = use the local CodeSage GPU service; ollama = fall back to Ollama jina-v2-base-code (CPU-friendly but lower quality)

runtime._note: Code graph is invoked on demand (templates/scripts/analyze_code_graph.py / templates/scripts/query_code_graph.py, delivered to each project as .claude/scripts/) rather than as a long-running process. The MCP entry points live in vct-kg's claude_mcp_servers/weaviate_mcp/server.py.

_mcp_note: No MCP of its own, so no mcp_registration: search_code_graph and query_code_structure are tools of the weaviate-kg MCP, which vct-kg (a depends_on of this module) serves and registers. This block used to register a `codegraph` MCP that no module or bundled server provides. It must not name weaviate-kg instead: uninstall deregisters the MCP an mcp_registration names, so uninstalling this module would remove vct-kg's MCP.

uninstall._note: Shared install_dir with vct-kg — do not remove the dir on uninstall. No MCP to deregister: the code graph tools belong to vct-kg's weaviate-kg MCP.

provides.description: search_code_graph, query_code_structure (dependencies/callers/methods/interactions) — served by the weaviate-kg MCP that vct-kg registers
